name: Kano Aoi
source: The charasmatic, 27th head of the Forbidden Date Club. He is the older brother of the highly influential and wealthy Kano brothers. As a result, he's very used to getting whatever he wants, whenever he wants and nobody seems to object to this. Aoi is crude and often rude, but his charm and good looks helps him avoid most troubles. Not at all studious, Aoi prefers to skip classes to "hang out" with girls on the school rooftop to "have fun". He thinks love is just a game, and treats the girls that come to the Forbidden Date Club like idiots and toys. When he gets bored with a girl, he just "throws her away like a used rag."
